name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=audio (FDOTHER.DAT SFX bank), descriptor encodes role + data type (sfx_bank buffer pointer). No Ghidra address residue, no domain-ID to preserve. The 'summon' qualifier is mildly broad -- the symbol is also used by the general inline spell-cast path in fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, not only the summon path -- but it is accurate (summon is the heaviest user), the type/role are correctly captured, and a rename would churn protos/globals.h plus 7 source files for a marginal scoping nuance. Keep.
purpose: Mutable global handle (4-byte pointer) to a malloc-backed FDOTHER.DAT SFX sample-bank buffer used during spell-cast cinematics; loaded per cast, played from by SFX functions, freed at teardown.
logic_summary: Lives in .bss (zero-initialized; raw memory at 0x5411F reads all zero). Two writers load it via fd2_load_dat_resource("FDOTHER.DAT", ...): fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence (index intro_sfx_bank[spell_id], the inline-spell path for spell_id 0x00-0x17/0x19-0x1B) and fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (index data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_sfx_bank_index_table[spell_id-0x20], the summon path 0x20-0x23). Both zero it first, then assign the loaded buffer. Read back (~30 sites) by those two casters, by fd2_play_figani_animation_loop, and by the summon animation tick handlers (fd2_tick_summon_* / fd2_render_summon_aura_sprite_ring / fd2_tick_summon_spell_*); each read passes it to fd2_play_sfx_with_handle / fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank to play a cued sample slot. At teardown each caster plays it out (handle -1) and free()s it.
datatype: uint32 (malloc-backed pointer handle stored as integer; Ghidra type undefined4/void*, src declares uint32)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer to the loaded FDOTHER.DAT SFX bank buffer (NULL when no bank is loaded).
comment_original_issue: src comment was accurate but slightly narrow: it described the readers only as 'summon animation tick handlers', omitting that fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence (general inline path) and fd2_play_figani_animation_loop also read it, and did not note the FDOTHER.DAT loader/index source.
